name: Bangers & mash with onion gravy
steps: Fry the sausages slowly until browned all over.
Boil the potatoes and mash them with milk and butter.
Soften the sliced onion in the sausage pan until golden.
Sprinkle over the flour and pour in the stock to make gravy.
Serve the sausages over the mash with onion gravy poured on top.
